indications.indication: Continuous glucose monitoring in diabetes / pre-diabetes
indications.trial_design: Pivotal device study supporting EU CE-mark and planned US FDA submission; insertable hydrogel biosensor read by external optical reader and smartphone app.

key_milestones: Pivotal study readout / data publication: Q4 2025 - Q2 2026

indications.indication: Tissue oxygen monitoring in peripheral arterial disease / critical limb ischemia (CLI / CLTI), including post-revascularization monitoring

indications.trial_status: ACTIVE — US pivotal study scheduled to begin Q4 2025-Q2 2026; FDA submission targeted Q3-Q4 2026.
key_milestones: US pivotal study start: Q4 2025 - Q2 2026
